notes: Real SplitEdge component and point clicks in one newly owned private Xvfb Rhino session, using public APIs/commands only. Each operation has two calibrated point prompts and actual Undo/Redo.
One-shot Cen is followed by persistent Point/End/Mid/Cen/Quad; one-shot End, Point or Mid is followed by persistent Cen only. The second point has no one-shot prefix in the actual macro.
Portable requests substitute the exact box source recipe for the shared 3DM artifact. Responses are compacted JSON without numerical normalization or array reordering.

The native kernel queries each actual click with recorded prompt-time camera/matrix and a 12-pixel capture radius. Its captured points, not Rhino output coordinates, drive complete ordered geometry/attribute/history replay at absolute 1e-9 and relative 1e-10.

These observations verify the tested feature targets and one-shot-to-persistent transitions. Native application tests independently exercise lifecycle, invalid input, cancellation, transparent CPlane scopes and real menu pointer events; those additional interactions are not claimed as camera-calibrated Rhino replays.

Mid-only segment-hover capture, generalized conic/closed-boundary recognition, occlusion, arbitrary mode combinations and complete one-shot/macro behavior remain unfinished. Earlier snap archives are unchanged.
